description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerIpcMock for unit testing, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for WebAudioPlayerIpc functionalities such as play, pause, setEos, getBufferAvailable, getBufferDelay, writeBuffer, getDeviceInfo, setVolume, and getVolume.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method of the WebAudioPlayerIpc interface.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method of the WebAudioPlayerIpc interface.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks the setEos method of the WebAudioPlayerIpc interface.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks the getBufferAvailable method, retrieving available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks the getBufferDelay method, retrieving buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks the writeBuffer method, writing a specified number of frames.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks the getDeviceInfo method, retrieving preferred and maximum frames and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks the setVolume method, setting the volume level.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks the getVolume method, retrieving the current volume level.
